curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show which manual sections the tests draw on and how the practice tests map to chapters.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on study material, sample questions and practice test topics.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on how to use the manual and practice tests.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the outside check, learning the controls and setting the seat, wheel and head restraint.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each pre-drive check and seat setting.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on pre-drive checks and seat position.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Set each mirror step by step, test the settings, and explain why head checks are still needed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each mirror setting and the blind spot rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on mirror adjustment and blind spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover buckling up, starting the engine, headlights and how automatic and manual transmissions are used.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on belts, starting, gear settings and clutch rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on starting the car and using the transmission.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain hand position, then compare push-pull and hand-over-hand steering.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on grip, hand position and each steering method.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on hand position and steering methods.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach backing up, pulling away, smooth stops, where to stop and curb parking distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on backing, moving off, stopping and parking.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on backing, stopping and parking.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain carbon monoxide risks, then the hands-free law and its school zone rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on carbon monoxide safety and each phone rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on carbon monoxide and phone laws.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec05-m01..sec05-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
